rationales.F04: Microscopic hematuria is a common finding in urethral amyloidosis.
rationales.F08: A circumferential urethral mass is highly suggestive of urethral amyloidosis.
rationales.F10: Amyloid protein deposition in biopsy specimens is diagnostic of amyloidosis.
rationales.F11: A 2-cm segment of stenosis in the penile urethra is consistent with urethral stenosis.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of amyloid protein deposition in biopsy specimens and the absence of evidence against Primary Amyloidosis of the Urethra decided it.
